mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade (user_id, sid, sdid, trade_type, trade_price, quantity, total_amount, remaining_balance, trade_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sid}, #{sdid}, #{tradeType}, #{tradePrice}, #{quantity}, #{totalAmount},#{remainingBalance}, #{tradeAt})
mapper.select: SELECT trade.tid, stock.sid, stock.company_name as companyName, stock.ticker as ticker, stock.sector as sector, stock.market as market, trade.trade_type as tradeType, trade.trade_price as tradePrice, trade.quantity, trade.total_amount as totalAmount, trade.remaining_balance as remainingBalance, trade.trade_at AS tradeAt, NULL as reasonTag, NULL as reasonText, st.status as settlementStatus, st.settle_date as settleDate FROM trade LEFT JOIN stock ON trade.sid = stock.sid LEFT JOIN reason ON reason.tid = trade.tid AND reason.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN settlement st ON st.tid = trade.tid WHERE trade.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY trade.trade_at DESC

SELECT tid, sid, sdid, trade_type as tradeType, trade_price as tradePrice, quantity, total_amount as totalAmount, remaining_balance as remainingBalance, trade_at AS tradeAt FROM trade WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sid = #{sid}

SELECT trade.tid, stock.sid, stock.company_name as companyName, stock.ticker as ticker, stock.sector as sector, stock.market as market, trade.trade_type as tradeType, trade.trade_price as tradePrice, trade.quantity, trade.total_amount as totalAmount, trade.remaining_balance as remainingBalance, trade.trade_at AS tradeAt, NULL as reasonTag, NULL as reasonText, st.status as settlementStatus, st.settle_date as settleDate FROM trade LEFT JOIN stock ON trade.sid = stock.sid LEFT JOIN reason ON reason.tid = trade.tid AND reason.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN settlement st ON st.tid = trade.tid WHERE trade.user_id = #{userId} AND trade.tid = #{tid}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT SUM(trade.quantity) FROM trade WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sid = #{sid}

SELECT trade.tid, stock.sid, stock.company_name as companyName, stock.ticker, stock.sector, stock.market, trade.trade_type as tradeType, trade.trade_price as tradePrice, trade.quantity, trade.total_amount as totalAmount, trade.remaining_balance as remainingBalance, trade.trade_at as tradeAt, reason.reason_tag as reasonTag, reason.reason_text as reasonText, st.status as settlementStatus, st.settle_date as settleDate FROM trade LEFT JOIN stock ON trade.sid = stock.sid LEFT JOIN reason ON reason.tid = trade.tid AND reason.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN settlement st ON st.tid = trade.tid WHERE trade.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(trade.trade_at) = #{date} ORDER BY trade.trade_at
